where: mockup D's own camera: leaning over the carved balustrade on the Well's south rim, looking steeply down the shaft
convention: layout.ts coordinates: x east, z SOUTH, y altitude (Lantern Square Y0 = +125); yaw 0 = north (-z), +90 = east (+x); pitch + up; eye = camera position (ground + 1.62 for standing views); hfov = horizontal FOV of a 2:3 PORTRAIT frame (the grid tile and the upscaled target, 1024x1536); look = a point on the view axis (the aim point for aerials)

views.name: look up
views.desc: from the mockup camera's spot looking steeply UP: the gallery walls and towers rising above the rim, bridges crossing high up, the paifang bridge from below, signs, lanterns, the sky screen with blue-green mountains

views.name: aerial above the rim
views.desc: a crane shot high above the rim looking steeply down the shaft: the rim balustrade at the bottom edge, the galleries of both walls dropping, the paifang bridge, lower bridges, the gondola, nets, mist and the temple far below

views.name: aerial in the shaft, back up
views.desc: hovering inside the shaft 18 m below the rim and 33 m north, looking back UP at the rim where the camera leans over the balustrade: the south wall's galleries below the rim, the balustrade with people, the towers above

views.name: turn left (down the west wall)
views.desc: from the same spot turned LEFT (west) and looking down: the west wall's galleries dropping away below the rim — verandas with people, lanterns, plants, birdcages, laundry, the magenta 麵 and cyan 牙科 signs

views.name: THE MOCKUP
views.desc: EXACTLY the mockup's camera and composition (image 1), without its HUD, hands, sword, claw or grapple line

views.name: turn right (down the east wall)
views.desc: from the same spot turned RIGHT (east) and looking down: the east wall's galleries dropping away — the red 火鍋, amber 茶 and magenta 旅館 signs, pipes, lanterns, people, the gondola station

views.name: turn around (south)
views.desc: from the same spot turned AROUND (south, away from the Well): the rim ledge's shopfronts under the towers, lit shops, lanterns, people with umbrellas, balconies and neon above

views.name: look straight down
views.desc: from the same spot looking STRAIGHT DOWN: the carved balustrade's wet top and a stone lion finial at the bottom edge, the south wall's galleries directly beneath, dropping floor after floor into the mist

views.name: aerial over the far end
views.desc: a high diagonal from the north end of the shaft looking down-south at the middle of the Well: the paifang bridge and its crowd, the lower bridges, the gondola, the galleries of both walls, the rim and its balustrade at the top
